\"// Dense matrix multiply C = A * B (PolyBench-style). Linear-algebra pattern.\n\n#define M 64\n#define N 64\n#define K 64\n\nvoid gemm(float A[M][K], float B[K][N], float C[M][N]) {\n#pragma HLS INTERFACE m_axi port=A bundle=peripheral offset=slave depth=1024\n#pragma HLS INTERFACE m_axi port=B bundle=peripheral offset=slave depth=1024\n#pragma HLS INTERFACE m_axi port=C bundle=peripheral offset=slave depth=1024\n#pragma HLS INTERFACE s_axilite port=return\n\n  for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {\n    // Partitioning applied to C to allow parallel writes/accesses in higher dimensions\n    #pragma HLS ARRAY_PARTITION variable=C complete dim=1\n    #pragma HLS ARRAY_PARTITION variable=C complete dim=2\n    for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {\n      float sum = 0.0f; // Local accumulation (acting as a local buffer)\n      for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) {\n        // Pipeline the innermost multiply-accumulate operation\n        #pragma HLS PIPELINE II=1\n        sum += A[i][k] * B[k][j];\n      }\n      C[i][j] = sum;\n    }\n  }\n}\"
